completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1962/ra_3476_1962.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the supervision of the Director of Public Schools, a school of fisheries in the Municipality of Narvacan, Province of Ilocos Sur. The site for the said school of fisheries shall be determined by the Director of Public Schools.
The Secretary of Education shall promulgate such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of the said fishery school during the fiscal year nineteen hundred and sixty-three. Such sums as may be needed for the same purpose in subsequent years, shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1962.
